title: Air Cleaner Removal and Installation
introduction:
This procedure covers the air cleaner assembly on the 3.7L Duratec. Loosen the outlet-pipe connection, remove the mounting bolt and take out the assembly; installation reverses that sequence.

I use the drawing as an attachment map: blue identifies the assembly, yellow identifies the pipe moved aside, and magenta highlights the clamp and mounting details. The lower inset is a useful reminder that the housing has a locating peg and grommet as well as a bolt—its mounting arrangement deserves more attention than a quick tug.

items.name: Confirm engine applicability
items.detail: Use this procedure for the stated engine configuration. A similar-looking air cleaner on another engine does not establish that its attachments or tightening specifications match.

items.name: Prevent an unexpected start
items.detail: disable remote start, if equipped, through the Central Display at Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup before working around the vehicle. Otherwise it could be remotely started at any time, causing personal injury or death. Switch the ignition OFF and remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person from accidentally starting the engine; an accidental start during service may cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Protect eyes, ears and hands
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection during service. Wear protective gloves when handling parts with pointed or sharp edges. Failure to use the required protection may result in serious personal injury.

items.name: Inspect cooling fans before underhood work
items.detail: With the ignition OFF, inspect all cooling fans for damage, cracks or separation. Do not work under the hood with a damaged fan; replace it with a new one before proceeding. A damaged fan can separate during operation and cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Disable fans before working nearby
items.detail: Cooling fans can run with the ignition off. If the work brings you near them, disable the fans before proceeding; unexpected operation may cause personal injury. Have the applicable disabling instructions available if this precaution is needed.

items.name: Use suitable tightening equipment
items.detail: Have a torque wrench suitable for the clamp and mounting-bolt specifications shown in their removal steps.

items.name: Hold flagnuts with a tool
items.detail: If the mounting fastener's flagnut needs to be held, use a tool rather than your fingers. Flagnuts can slip or spin unexpectedly during fastener removal and injure fingers.

edits.text: NOTE: Read the removal steps before starting; they may also contain details needed for installation.
edits.why: The clamp and bolt tightening specifications are recorded beside removal and must be used during refitting.

edits.text: Loosen the clamp at the air cleaner outlet connection, then move the air cleaner outlet pipe aside. When reconnecting the pipe during installation, tighten the clamp to 48 lb.in (5.4 Nm).
edits.why: Moving the pipe clear releases the connection between the air cleaner housing and the downstream pipe. The yellow pipe and magenta clamp in the drawing identify the connection to separate.

edits.text: Remove the air cleaner mounting bolt shown in the upper inset. During installation, tighten the bolt to 71 lb.in (8 Nm).
edits.why: The inset identifies the mounting attachment so it can be distinguished from the nearby pipe clamp. The stated torque applies when the bolt is refitted.

edits.text: Remove the air cleaner assembly, freeing its locating peg from the mounting grommet shown in the lower inset.
edits.why: The grommet is another locating point for the housing. Recognizing it explains why removing the bolt alone does not completely free the assembly from its mounts.

edits.text: Install by reversing removal: position the air cleaner assembly with its locating peg seated in the illustrated grommet, refit the mounting bolt, then reconnect the outlet pipe and tighten its clamp. Use the installation tightening specifications given beside the corresponding removal steps.
edits.why: I finish by checking the mounting points and the pipe connection against the drawing. A seated locating peg, secured mounting bolt and reconnected clamped pipe account for the attachments released during removal.

powerLabelClarification.reason: Avoid repeating internally inconsistent power-unit parenthetical as an editorial specification. Retain3.7L Duratec application; do not invent a corrected power output. Original source is unchanged.
